title: LIN-4254 piece 4: swipe / prompt-section / dispatch-slice suites onto loadWorld
description:
**Piece 4 of LIN-4254: the swipe / prompt-section / dispatch slice.** Lands after Piece 3.

## Slice of the approved plan

* `tests/unit/runner-link-surfaces.test.js`: loads `swipe.js`; an auto-vivifier (`el(sel)` at `:184`).
* `tests/unit/task-page-link-client-surfaces.test.js`: loads `swipe.js`; an auto-vivifier (`:47`) that stubs `style: {}`. **Expected stop candidate** (`swipe.js` has 26 `style`/layout hits; the ticket listed it as "feasible" in error).
* `tests/unit/run-limit-gating.test.js`: loads `prompt-section.js`. Its stub (`:121`) is a plain `querySelector() { return null; }`. The LIN-4292 pre-check is moot (landed as `b389f9b0`), so it moves like the others.
* `tests/unit/lin-2122-history-outcome-pill.test.js`: slices `dispatch.js` by `indexOf`. Use `loadWorld({ scripts: [] })` + `world.run`.

The two swipe loaders must parse the page markup first, because `swipe.js:84` queries `.swipe-filter-select` at load and `loadWorld` has no `markup` option. So: `loadWorld({ scripts: [] })`, then `parse(markup, document.body)`, then `world.run(swipeSource)`. Markup comes from the server's real renderer. Piece 0's probe result (on LIN-4254) decides whether each swipe loader moves or stays listed with a `// stop:` comment (API + `file:line`).

## Acceptance

* Each of the four files is either on `loadWorld` with its sandbox deleted and its census entry removed, or still listed with a true stop comment.
* Names and counts are preserved.
* Newly red tests are classified.
* Census, line budget and full unit suite are green.

---

**Parent:** LIN-4254 (Move the 16 not-attempted client-test stubs onto the shared fake). This piece's starting point is the parent's approved **Implementation Plan** in LIN-4254's description, plus the builder notes in its approving Plan Review Verdict (comment `c1d9a66c-fb1a-4f25-903c-e11227c24ba7`). Follow it. Where the code shows it wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4254.

**Rules for every piece (from the plan):** "Moved" means the suite runs on `loadWorld` (`tests/unit/helpers/client-world.js` over `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js`) and its private `vm.createContext` sandbox is deleted. Do not wrap the old sandbox around the fake. Slices and scripts that query the DOM at load use `loadWorld({ scripts: [] })`, then `parse(markup, document.body)`, then `world.run(source)`, as `observation-ruling-delivery` and LIN-4284 do. Router markup comes from the server's real renderer where one exists, not from hand-written HTML. Do not widen the fake. A file that hits an API the fake does not model (a `FakeDomError`, a `style` or layout read, or an unmodelled method such as `click()`) stays on `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` with a `// stop:` comment naming the API and `file:line`. A `querySelector: () => null` stub that becomes a real tree can bring dead paths to life. A test that goes red there is a finding: classify it as a real client bug, a vacuous pass or a fake gap, and list it in the PR. Never loosen the test. Test names are kept. Do not split a file to keep a count, and do not copy a fixture.

**Testing strategy (every move PR):** an assertion map; before/after sorted test names, diffed against base; one mutation per load-bearing assertion, showing it goes red; and green runs of `fake-dom-census.test.js`, `claude-md-line-budget.test.js` and the full unit suite. The census count only falls. Every remaining entry's reason is true at merge.

**Grounding commits:** plan and approving review at `b581ac92` (Surveys at `b581ac926`); LIN-4292 landed as `b389f9b0`. Re-check `git log b581ac92..origin/main -- tests/unit public` before starting.

**Session fit:** fits one session
**Plan-review due:** no — covered by LIN-4254's approving plan-review (comment c1d9a66c-fb1a-4f25-903c-e11227c24ba7, rev 2)

## Moved here from piece 1: export `laneNode` (the person's ruling on LIN-4307, 2026-11-06)

The 21:35 call's loader fix #4 belongs to this piece. Its only consumer is `task-page-link-client-surfaces`, which is in this piece.

* **Export** `laneNode` **from where it lives:** `public/live-console.js:1239`. It closes over `reducedMotion`, `nodeFromHtml` (`:162`) and `updateLaneNode` (`:1281`) inside the file's IIFE, so the export is a new `window` global in `public/live-console.js` (for example `window.LiveConsoleLane = { laneNode }`). That global is a production change: name it in the PR.
* **Don't copy the template into a test.** `tests/unit/helpers/live-console-world.js` already holds a copy of the lane markup (`LANE_CONTENTS`, `makeLaneNode`) because `laneNode` isn't exported. Once it is, have `makeLaneNode` call the real `laneNode` and delete the copy. If a test still needs the copy, say why in the PR.
* **Fix #1 has landed in piece 1:** `loadWorld`'s `window` is now the global object (LIN-4307, pinned in `client-world.test.js`). A `common.js` `window.isTerminalState` is now visible to `swipe.js`'s bare call without any per-suite `Object.assign(globalThis, window)` bridge. Don't add one.

## Implemented (close-out)

Implemented as approved in LIN-4254's plan, no deviations: the four suites run on `loadWorld`, their sandboxes and `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` entries are gone, swipe markup comes from the real `renderSwipePage`, and `window.LiveConsoleLane = { laneNode }` replaces the copied lane template. PR: [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2329](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2329>) (squash `ff6a69fa`). Review fixes are in `18c52b79`. Full history is in the task snapshots and the comment trail.

parent.title: Move the 16 not-attempted client-test stubs onto the shared fake (LIN-4255 leftovers)

comments.body:
LIN-4310 implemented: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2329 (commit fb3efd88, branch feat/lin-4310-swipe-prompt-dispatch-loadworld).

- Moved to loadWorld, none stopped: runner-link-surfaces (27), task-page-link-client-surfaces (12), run-limit-gating (16), lin-2122-history-outcome-pill (14). Names and counts unchanged; sorted names identical to origin/main.
- Removed all four from HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES; census green.
- Production change: public/live-console.js exports window.LiveConsoleLane = { laneNode }; the copied lane template in helpers/live-console-world.js is gone.
- Evidence: 21 mutations each red on the intended test, files restored; npm run test:unit 23,900/0 fail; test:hermetic:keyed pass.
- CI on the PR: CI success, Unit tests, Secret scan and all four E2E shards pass.
- Judgment call (in PR body): lin-2122 escape check reads the live tree, since the serializer leaves < bare in attribute values.

## Review — LIN-4310 PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2329, head `fb3efd88bfe9b6b4eb9088c04bbd987ce8f16f09` (merge-base `8b84a8fe`). CI: green on head fb3efd88. Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan (source) and CI success all pass. Mergeable. ### Scope vs plan The four suites the ticket names are all on `loadWorld`. Their `vm.createContext` sandboxes are gone, and their four `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` entries are removed. None stopped, which matches the LIN-4306 probe. Swipe markup comes from the real `renderSwipePage` (new `helpers/swipe-page.js`), not hand-written HTML. There's no `Object.assign(globalThis, window)` bridge. The production change, `window.LiveConsoleLane = { laneNode }`, is named in the PR, and the `LANE_CONTENTS` copy is deleted. Nothing changed beyond the plan's files. I re-ran the 8 affected suites locally on the head (the 4 moved files, the 2 lane consumers, census and line budget): 160/160 pass. Regression check: `git log` on the touched files shows the LIN-4285 / LIN-4292 / LIN-2122 / LIN-4035 / LIN-3977 work still in place. Nothing is reverted or re-applied. ### Mutation checks (mine, every one reverted, tree clean afterwards) - **M1. Drop `li.classList.toggle('lc-lane--pulse', !reducedMotion)` from `updateLaneNode` (`public/live-console.js:1282`).** On the PR head, `live-console-client-facts` › *"the lane node reads the live flag, so a reused node follows the change"* stays **green**. On origin/main the same mutation turns it **red**. Cause: the old fixture lane had no pulse class. The real `laneNode` adds `lc-lane--pulse` itself at build (`:1240`), so the test's premise ("The lane starts without the pulse class, so the class on the node is the client's write", `live-console-client-facts.test.js:124`) is now false and the test is vacuous. This side effect of this ticket's fixture change is a vacuous pass, and the PR doesn't list it. - **M2. Unescape the class fragment `status-${escapeHtml(outcome)}` (`public/dispatch.js:1124`).** The new lin-2122 escape test stays **green**. The base test goes **red**. - **M3. Unescape `data-status="${escapeHtml(outcome)}"` (`public/dispatch.js:1158`).** The new test stays **green**. The base test goes **red**. The live-tree rewrite is right that the serializer leaves `<` bare inside an attribute. But with a word that has no `"`, an unescaped attribute never creates an element. The new test therefore covers only the label escape, which makes it looser than before for 2 of the 3 escape sites. The PR body says "not a looser one", and these mutations show that's wrong. - I tested both fixes below locally. With them, M1, M2, M3 and the label unescape each go red, and the clean source passes 26/26 across the two files. ### Isolated, or one of a class? The class is "a test premise that held only because the copied lane fixture differed from the real `laneNode`". I checked every other `makeLaneNode` consumer (`lin-4035-live-console-client`, the rest of `live-console-client-facts`, `task-page-link-client-surfaces`). Their `hidden` assertions stay meaningful, because `updateLaneNode` writes `hidden` unconditionally on the title, separator, run and cred. M1 is the only instance. **Inside**: it's caused by this ticket's removal of the copied template. ### What CI Did Not Prove - **Inside: the pulse test is vacuous (M1).** It belongs to this ticket's lane-fixture change. Settle **before the merge** in `tests/unit/live-console-client-facts.test.js`. In *"the lane node reads the live flag…"*, add `li.classList.remove('lc-lane--pulse');` straight after `const li = makeLaneNode(world);`, and keep the comment, which is then true again. Distinguishing check: with `public/live-console.js:1282` deleted, the test must go red. - **Inside: the lin-2122 escape test misses attribute escaping (M2/M3).** It's this ticket's rewritten assertion. Settle **before the merge** in `tests/unit/lin-2122-history-outcome-pill.test.js:179`. Change `const word = '';` to `const word = '">';` and leave both assertions unchanged. Distinguishing check: unescaping any one of `dispatch.js:1124` class, `:1158` data-status or `:1125` label must turn the test red. Also fix the PR body's "not a looser one" note to describe the quote-bearing word. - **Inside: stale header comments.** `tests/unit/lin-4035-live-console-client.test.js:9` and `tests/unit/live-console-client-facts.test.js:8` still say "The lane is supplied as markup (makeLaneNode)". They should say the lane is the client's own `laneNode` via `makeLaneNode` (LIN-4310). Settle before the merge. - **Inside: main has moved.** origin/main has `f2816e17` (LIN-4317) past the merge-base, and it touches `lib/render.js`, which `runner-link-surfaces` imports. Settle **before the merge**: close-out re-checks CI green on the exact commit it merges, after the fixes above. - **Outside: production reach of `window.LiveConsoleLane`.** It's an inert new global and nothing reads it. E2E shards are green. Nothing more to settle; it's noted only because it's a production change. **Named rollback:** revert `fb3efd88`. ### Verdict Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger. The migration is complete and matches the plan. Two test-strength regressions caused by the fixture change (M1 pulse premise, M2/M3 attribute escaping) need the precise one-line fixes above, then CI green on the merged commit.

## Close-out — LIN-4310 **Merged:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2329, squash commit `ff6a69fa`, pinned with `--match-head-commit add7e779` (the head CI passed on). **Changes I made after the Approve** (commit `18c52b79`, then `add7e779` = merge of `origin/main` @ `f2816e17`, LIN-4317, no conflicts): - `tests/unit/live-console-client-facts.test.js` — `li.classList.remove('lc-lane--pulse')` after `makeLaneNode(world)`. Answers review M1 (vacuous pulse test). - `tests/unit/lin-2122-history-outcome-pill.test.js:179` — word is now `">`, assertions unchanged, comment updated. Answers review M2/M3. - Header comments in `lin-4035-live-console-client.test.js` and `live-console-client-facts.test.js` now say the lane is the client's own `laneNode` via `makeLaneNode` (LIN-4310). Answers the stale-comment item. - PR body: the "not a looser one" note is replaced with a correction describing the quote-bearing word. **Ledger** - M1 pulse test vacuous (inside): fixed. Distinguishing check run: deleting `public/live-console.js:1282` turns *"the lane node reads the live flag…"* red (25 pass / 1 fail). - M2/M3 escape test (inside): fixed. Unescaping the class (`dispatch.js:1124`), the label (`:1125`) or `data-status` (`:1158`) each turns *"an outcome word is escaped…"* red. Sources restored after every mutation. Clean run is 26/26 on the two files. - Stale header comments (inside): fixed in `18c52b79`. - Main moved (inside): merged `f2816e17` in, then re-ran CI on the new head. The full unit suite was 23,923/23,923. Census and line budget were green (51/51 together). - Production reach of `window.LiveConsoleLane` (outside): the global is inert and nothing reads it. The named rollback is review's: revert `fb3efd88` (now inside the squash `ff6a69fa`). No follow-up ticket needed. **CI:** green on `add7e779`: CI success, Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan. After the merge, the 8 affected suites on `main` @ `ff6a69fa` passed 160/160. The post-merge CI run on `ff6a69fa` was still in progress when I closed. It is not a gate. **Post-deploy:** the change is test-only plus the inert global, and the ticket names no post-deploy step. I could not read a deployed-commit indicator from this session, so I did not confirm the deploy landed. Not run: confirming `window.LiveConsoleLane` on the live `live-console.js`. That check is cheap for the operator to run. **Related tickets:** LIN-4311 (blocked by this one) and LIN-4312 stay open as the remaining pieces of LIN-4254. No follow-ups filed, since nothing was outside the work. Description: archived (snapshot verified), and an "Implemented" stub added. The problem statement, acceptance and the plan-review line were kept word for word.
